title: Quick capture
statement: The app shall let a user add a task with a title alone, from launch, in at most two interactions.

title: Lists
statement: The system shall organise tasks into any number of user-named lists, one of which is an Inbox that always exists.

title: Due reminders
statement: The system shall notify the user at a task's due time, unless the task is done by then.

title: Snooze
statement: The system shall let a user snooze a reminder by 10 minutes, by 1 hour, or until 09:00 the next day.

title: Same tasks everywhere
statement: The system shall make a change visible on every device signed in to the same iCloud account within 30 seconds, while they are online.

title: Offline first
statement: The system shall work fully without a network connection and sync every change once one returns.

title: Today on the home screen
statement: The system shall show the tasks due today on the home screen, without opening the app.

title: Nowhere but iCloud
statement: The system shall send task data nowhere but the user's own iCloud private database.

title: Concurrent edits
statement: The system shall resolve two edits to the same field of a task by keeping the later one, and shall keep edits to different fields.
source: OQ-0402. **Reopened 2026-10-02**: per field, not per task.
